events.title: The birth of St. Joan of Arc
events.shortBlurb: The Maid of Orléans, who would lift the siege of Orléans and see the king crowned before dying at the stake, was born at Domrémy…
body: By long tradition Joan of Arc was born on or about 6 January 1412 at Domrémy in Lorraine, the daughter of a peasant farmer, in the midst of the Hundred Years' War when much of France lay under English arms. From about the age of thirteen she believed herself called by heavenly voices to save her country.

Her brief public career carried her from the relief of Orléans in 1429 to the crowning of Charles VII at Reims, and then to capture, trial, and death by fire at Rouen in 1431. Rehabilitated after a later inquiry, she was canonized in 1920 and is honored as a patroness of France.
